summary: @arv-bedrock/logger preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a NestJS/Winston logger but its preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub oven-sh releases, extracts it, chmods it executable, and then invokes it to run `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle bearing the `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and using obfuscator.io-style string-array shuffling (`n7gIxM` constant array, `WV8StW` rotator, hex-mangled identifiers). The bundle is not imported by the shipped logger code in `dist/` and is executed only through the freshly downloaded alternate runtime, so its behavior is opaque to Node-based tooling. Fetching a second-language runtime solely to execute an obfuscated blob unrelated to the package's stated purpose on every install is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, and the execution fires automatically via the `preinstall` lifecycle on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
